articles.title: 'Growing Chance' Of Tesla Merger To Create Musk Trinity With SpaceX And xAI
articles.mainIdea: 'Growing Chance' Of Tesla Merger To Create Musk Trinity With SpaceX And xAI
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: 'Growing Chance' Of Tesla Merger To Create Musk Trinity With SpaceX And xAI. Tesla CEO Elon Musk confirmed late Monday that his rocket company SpaceX will merge with his artificial intelligence startup xAI. On Tuesday, a Tesla stock bull wrote there is now a "growing chance" that Tesla will eventually merge "in some form" with SpaceX/xAI in the coming 18 months. Wedbush Securities analyst Dan Ives, who has long been bullish on Tesla and Musk's vision for the company, wrote early Tuesday that Tesla appears to be looking to combine its capabilities to create a "long-term AI juggernaut" to dominate the AI, robotics and energy space. Related tickers mentioned: TSLA, XAAI.PVT.
